countyFips.what: Most populous county (or county equivalent) in each state; DC is the District itself.
countyFips.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2024 county population estimates (CO-EST2024-ALLDATA), POPESTIMATE2024, SUMLEV 050.
countyFips.note: Connecticut is reported on the nine planning regions that replaced its counties in 2022; 09110 is the Capitol Planning Region (Hartford).

monthlyRent.what: Two-bedroom Fair Market Rent for that county, in whole dollars per month.
monthlyRent.publisher: HUD Office of Policy Development and Research, FY2026 Fair Market Rents, county level, revised schedule (fmr_2).
monthlyRent.vintage: FY2026 (effective 2025-10-01), revised file, which differs from the unrevised FY26_FMRs.xlsx in 9 of 4,764 rows (Los Angeles, Napa and San Luis Obispo CA; Buncombe and Henderson NC, plus their metro rows).
monthlyRent.note: In the six New England states HUD publishes FMRs by town, not by county, and a county can span two or three FMR areas. Those counties take the population-weighted mean of their town rows using HUD's own pop2023 column, rounded to the dollar: ME 23005 ($1,833/$2,130 -> 2,082), MA 25017 ($2,351/$2,941 -> 2,825), NH 33011 ($1,698/$2,037/$2,127 -> 2,058). CT 09110, RI 44007 and VT 50007 are single-valued across their towns. Every other state's county is one row.

monthlyChildcarePreschool.what: Median county price of center-based care for a preschooler (ages 3-5), in whole 2026 dollars per month.
monthlyChildcarePreschool.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Women's Bureau, National Database of Childcare Prices (NDCP), variable MCPreschool (median weekly full-time price).
monthlyChildcarePreschool.vintage: NDCP study years 2008-2018; each county contributes its own most recent year with a price (2018 for most; 2012 for DC, 2015 for CO, 2016 for GA/LA/MT, 2017 for IA).
monthlyChildcarePreschool.arithmetic: weekly price x 52 / 12 = monthly, then x the BLS Employment Cost Index factor from that county's study year to CY2026, then the state median across counties, rounded to the dollar. ECI factors (series CIU2020000000000I, wages and salaries, private industry workers, index NSA; calendar-year averages of the four quarterly index values, 2026 Q3 and Q4 projected from the same quarter of 2025 at the latest published 12-month rate of 3.138%, exactly as scripts/build-reach.mjs does): CY2026 avg 179.746; 2012 -> 1.548866, 2013 -> 1.520371, 2014 -> 1.490430, 2015 -> 1.457202, 2016 -> 1.423730, 2017 -> 1.387999, 2018 -> 1.347420. The same arithmetic on CY2024 (168.375) reproduces the 1.067533 the reach ladders use.
monthlyChildcarePreschool.note: The NDCP publishes no center-based price for Indiana or New Mexico in any year, so both take the national median county price from the 2018 cross-section (2,340 counties) on the same arithmetic: $730/month. DOL's derived 'Childcare Prices by Age of Children and Care Setting' table (Data-Table-2023.xlsx) was NOT used: for the states the NDCP leaves blank in 2018 it carries the weekly price in an annual column, giving Denver County a $36,101/year preschool price and a $693,417/year home-based price.
